interpretation: The verified zero-shot model has strong heterogeneity across target-domain images: median Dice is 0.1823 while the 90th percentile is 0.8650.
Predicted-to-target instance count is substantially above 1 on average, indicating frequent instance fragmentation/over-segmentation, but its simple correlation with Dice is weak in this sample.
Image width and height show negative descriptive correlations with Dice, suggesting image-size/content interaction is worth testing in controlled analysis.
These are descriptive observations from the fixed zero-shot run; they do not establish causality and were not used to tune the checkpoint.
